title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Structured Metadata and Climate Science Publications
abstract: arXiv:2610.32725v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid expansion of scientific literature far outpaces the speed of manual curation, creating a fundamental bottleneck in extracting structured knowledge from scientific texts. To address this, we introduce an agentic, ontology-guided framework for knowledge graph (KG) construction. Our framework utilizes specialized agents for document understanding, information extraction, ontology conformance, and entity linking. First, an LLM extracts factual knowledge in the form of triples with explicit textual evidence from research papers. Then the triplets undergo a multistage verification process to ground the triplets in the ontology. By enforcing schema constraints and requiring evidence in the form of text fragments, we ensure the data is both semantically consistent and traceable. translated_abstract: 科学文献的快速扩张远远超出了人工整理的速度，这为从科学文本中提取结构化知识造成了根本性瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种代理式、本体引导的知识图谱（KG）构建框架。该框架利用专门的代理分别执行文档理解、信息抽取、本体一致性检查和实体链接任务。首先，大语言模型（LLM）从研究论文中以三元组的形式抽取事实知识，并附带明确的文本证据。随后，三元组经过多阶段验证流程，使其锚定于本体之上。通过强制执行模式约束并要求提供文本片段形式的证据，我们确保了数据在语义上的一致性和可追溯性。在一项针对1000个抽取三元组的一致性研究中，Gemini-2.5-flash 相对于三位人类标注者取得了 0.640–0.700 的 Cohen's κ 分数，达到（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种代理式、本体引导的知识图谱构建框架，利用大语言模型从气候科学文献中抽取带文本证据的三元组，并通过多阶段验证确保语义一致性与可追溯性，抽取质量接近人类标注者水平。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an agentic, ontology-guided knowledge graph construction framework that uses LLMs to extract evidence-grounded triples from climate science publications, with multistage verification ensuring semantic consistency and traceability at near-human annotation quality.
